VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 83 tests pass and the edge case is resolved, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The absence of CI logs is particularly problematic for verifying that the full test suite actually passed. Self-reports lack the objectivity needed to confirm technical acceptance criteria have been met.
